tw: Kron parks his car in the Arctic, and a shark barks in the dark.
twc: Kron 把车停在北极，黑暗里一条鲨鱼汪汪叫。

tw: Kron and silly Billy the goat fill a hilly field with chilli.
twc: Kron 和傻乎乎的山羊比利把山坡地灌满了辣椒酱。

tw: Kron puts pepper on a pebble, and his pet pelican pecks it with pep.
twc: Kron 在鹅卵石上撒胡椒，他的宠物鹈鹕兴冲冲地啄起来。

tw: Kron tries to cut up a coconut in his hut, and the nut wins.
twc: Kron 在小屋里想把椰子切碎，结果椰子赢了。

tw: Kron uses six chopsticks to mix a big pink drink for a fox.
twc: Kron 用六根筷子给一只狐狸调一大杯粉色饮料。

tw: Kron tries to bake a cake on a lake, and a snake takes the cake.
twc: Kron 想在湖上烤蛋糕，一条蛇把蛋糕拿走了。

tw: A dove in a glove flies out of Kron's oven and up above.
twc: 一只戴手套的鸽子从 Kron 的烤箱里飞了出来，飞上了天。

say: pour the soup into his boot
tw: Kron has no bowl, so he must pour the soup into his boot, then four more.
twc: Kron 没有碗，只好把汤倒进靴子里，还又倒了四只。

tw: Kron takes a flour shower for an hour and turns into a white tower.
twc: Kron 洗了一个小时的面粉澡，变成了一座白塔。

tw: Kron puts a toy in a foil pot to boil, and it comes out royal.
twc: Kron 把玩具放进锡纸锅里煮，捞出来竟成了国王。

tw: Kron rubs butter on each button, and now not one button will shut.
twc: Kron 给每颗纽扣都抹了黄油，现在一颗都扣不上。

tw: Kron says "Cheese, please," and three mice sneeze on his knees.
twc: Kron 说“茄子，拜托”，三只老鼠在他膝盖上打喷嚏。

tw: Kron tries to cut the bun in half, and a hungry pup jumps up.
twc: Kron 正要把面包切成两半，一只饿坏的小狗跳了起来。

tw: Kron takes a tablespoon of moon from a table in a big balloon.
twc: Kron 坐在大热气球里的桌边，舀了一汤匙月亮。

tw: Kron does a flash dash to mash ten potatoes: crash, smash, splash!
twc: Kron 一个闪电冲刺去捣十个土豆：咣、啪、哗！

tw: Kron makes a mashed potato moustache, and a cat dashes off with it.
twc: Kron 用土豆泥做了个小胡子，一只猫叼着它就跑。

tw: Kron tosses his stir-fry sky high, and a third bird flies off with it.
twc: Kron 把炒菜抛上天，第三只鸟叼着它飞走了。

tw: What can Kron do with two blue shoes full of glue?
twc: Kron 拿两只装满胶水的蓝鞋子能怎么办？

tw: Kron wears a gold bowl on his head, and an old goat bowls him.
twc: Kron 把金碗戴在头上，一只老山羊把他当保龄球打了出去。

tw: Kron turns up the heat, and twelve sweet treats melt on his feet.
twc: Kron 把温度调高，十二块甜点在他脚上化了。
